author: bruno2008
quote: You have to pay 80 bucks to not even have everything, for a game that was developed for 13 years, with 2B of funds, and if u want everything, u have to pay an extra 20, making the total game 100 bucks, and, the game comes out with horrible bugs, which sometimes even flames the story and you have to redo everything, this isn't inflation, that's robbery of the fans.

author: bruno2008
quote: You may ask why I've put the max points in if, well, I could say it comes back from a long time ago, this game as been going with me and my entire childhood, I've been so happy with it, it's the only one I know by heart and mind, so, please, keep this game alive.
